title: Black ball darting around the security truck
place_text: November-5 launch facility, near Nisland, South Dakota

tellings.quote: this black ball about six times the size of a beach ball looked as if it had vents or something on it
This this black ball just comes out of nowhere. And honestly, it was between four and six feet in diameter,
tellings.difference: Gives the size as four to six feet in diameter.
tellings.link_reason: The same vented black ball circling the security truck at November 5 in 1977.

as_told.title: Black ball with vents circles the truck
as_told.place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

plain: A former missile site guard named Mario Woods says that in 1977, at a nuclear launch site called November-5 near Nisland, South Dakota, a black ball "about six times the size of a beach ball", which seemed to have vents on it, came out of nowhere and darted around his security truck. Woods tells it as his own experience, with a man named Michael Johnson, and in a later telling gives its size as four to six feet across.
